  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./ResIm50E2.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from PBS:
#   walltime=72:00:00 -> -t 72h

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: PBS -l place=scatter:excl not translated.
  # Performance implication: without explicit placement/exclusivity semantics, placement/node-sharing behavior may differ and performance can change.

  # NOTE: PBS -l powerai=on not translated.
  # Performance implication: if this toggles special software stack/firmware settings, omission may change performance or environment.

  # NOTE: PBS -N ResIm50E2 not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: PBS -j oe not translated.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: stdout/stderr handling follows Flux defaults unless configured.

  # NOTE: PBS -V not translated.
  # Performance implication: usually none (Flux typically inherits the environment), but if your site sanitizes environments, behavior may differ.

  # NOTE: PBS -q standard not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, scheduling/priority may differ.

  # NOTE: PBS -A MHPCC96650NRL not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require account/project out-of-band.

  # NOTE: The original script submits a follow-on job via `qsub`.
  # Flux does not run `qsub`. This step is omitted.
  # Performance implication: downstream workflow will not be scheduled, reducing throughput/automation.

  . /usr/share/Modules/init/sh
  module load glog/0.3.3
  module load gflags/2.2.0

  export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/protobuf/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/boost/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/lmdb/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/leveldb/lib:/gpfs/pkgs/mhpcc/opencv-3.4.0/lib64

"
